title: Register with the construction industry long service scheme
what: Register with the scheme as an employer of workers covered by the state or territory's portable long service leave scheme.

laws.title: Construction Industry Long Service Leave and Benefits Act 2005 (NT)

sources.title: Construction Industry Long Service Leave and Benefits Act 2005 (NT)
sources.quote: Registration (1) A person must apply to be registered as an employer within the time mentioned in subsection (3) if the person: (a) employs one or more registered employees to carry out construction work in the Territory

administration.who: NT Build (Construction Industry Long Service Leave and Benefits Board)

sources.title: Construction Industry Long Service Leave and Benefits Act 2005 (NT)
sources.locator: s 6, words naming the body (found 12 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Board means the Board established by section 53.

reach.condition: if it employs workers in the building and construction industry as the state scheme defines it

sources.title: Portable long service leave employer registration
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need to register with NT Build if you are an employer who employs construction workers that are registered for the portable long service leave scheme.

confidence_note: Quoted from the law's current text on 10 Nov 2026, replacing the ABLIS-first draft (methods rule 5a); the ABLIS listing stays as a reach source.

assessment.summary: Employers in a covered industry must register with its portable long service leave scheme.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
